title: Annual Leave Policy

The employee must use the approved Human Resources process and keep the manager or HR contact informed. The record should include the request, responsible person, dates, supporting evidence, and final decision. HR protects personal information, checks that the process is fair, and reviews exceptions instead of treating an informal conversation as approval. This also explains when notice is needed, what approval means, how an absence or schedule change is recorded, and who handles an exception. The employee should not assume that telling a coworker is the same as completing the official process.
